records.name: Humane Ai Pin
records.summary: Humane announced the end of consumer Ai Pin server connectivity and .Center access at noon PST on February 28, 2025. Its notice identified calling, messaging, AI queries/responses and cloud features, asked users to export pictures/videos/notes before the deadline, and said remaining consumer data would be permanently deleted at that time. The announced export deadline has passed.
